neg_tools_list_reorder.neutralized_signal: tools_sha256 identical across all three listings
neg_tools_list_reorder.rationale: Servers legitimately reshuffle tools/list between calls (map iteration, pagination). The digest sorts by tool name before hashing (mcp_client.tools_digest), so order is not in the hash; the harness recomputes the digest independently and proves both listings hash equal AND that the digest is not dead weight (see atck_reorder_then_append).
